title: Session start refreshes a stale claude-settings clone, so a restart brings main's hooks
why: Coordinator 18:42 CST Nov 9: when hooks/session_start.sh finds 'has local commits on main that main lacks' in /root/claude-settings-main, it keeps the clone as is, so a restart never refreshes the hooks. Seen in lane commit-refuses-conflict-markers (session_013NEJKzXJPDWrSRe3i1fGJd, still no merge_route_paths after a restart) and in the coordinator's container. Harm: lanes cannot get guard fixes from main; today it blocked mixed merges in several lanes.
note: Fix: say how a cloud clone gets local commits on main, or prove the message a false alarm (step pointer-move-unseen's 11:34 CST finding: the message printed while origin/main..HEAD was empty), then refresh or archive them. Reads #2458 (pointer-move-unseen) and #2473 (live-hooks-lag-named) first; starts after nothing. Split from pointer-move-unseen so #2458 does not grow. Lane session_013NEJKzLxn6c25hHUunkJmW started 18:45 CST Nov 9, plan first (coordinator). Writer (coordinator 18:51 CST Nov 9): merge/launch.py:60 fast-forwards the cloud mirror (git merge --ff-only origin/main) without updating mirrorSha, so install.sh sees main != mirrorSha, warns 'local commits' falsely and skips the refresh. Proven by the coordinator container's mirror reflog: seven 'merge origin/main: Fast-forward' entries, 11228 commits all main's own. #2458 fixes the symptom. The cause fix, launch.py skipping cloudMirror checkouts, is built in this lane. PR #2477 released into batch-70c (review record 6756907312; coordinator 20:10 CST Nov 9). Note merge-ff-main-moves-cloud-mirror holds the second fast-forward site. Second incident (Degen gap 1; Owner 20:25 CST Nov 9: queue each of Degen's eight claude-settings gaps as a step or debt, with its incident (via the coordinator 20:30 CST).): Degen lane ci-addon-image's guard lacked FIX_CHECK, 2026-11-09 04:56 CST, because cloud lane hooks stay stale until a resume. If #2477 does not cover a fresh container, that needs its own step.
